title: The CyberUnicorn console sends its device log to support when something goes wrong

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-21 in the project thread: 'I cannot use control C and the copy button didnt' work', then chose 'Yes, send it automatically' on 'Should the console send its device log to me when errors happen?'.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-21. PREMISE: the device log lived only in the browser tab, so diagnosing a failed placard write needed the owner to copy text out of the console mid-demo. Now every problem the console shows (and every Copy log press) calls reportConsoleLog (lib/devices/log-actions.ts): consoleStaffGate, at most 60 lines of 400 chars, signed /c/ links and ?s= signatures cut server side, written to the runtime log as one `[cu5k-log]` line. Nothing is stored in the database.

verify.note: Fails when the action loses its staff gate or its redaction, stops writing [cu5k-log], or the console stops calling it on a problem or a Copy log press.
